      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",

      "affected_purpose": "A",

    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "There shall be no discharge of visible films of oil, globules of oil, grease or solids in or on the water, or coatings on stream banks.",
      "affected_purpose": "A",
      "computation_change_reason": "Compliance depends on interpreting 'visible' films/globules and what counts as a prohibited discharge; different readings change whether measurements are judged to exceed the applicable limit or fall outside numeric comparison."
    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "Samples taken in compliance with the monitoring requirements specified above shall be taken at the discharge after the treatment system and prior to the receiving stream.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Establishes where monitoring must occur and references unspecified 'monitoring requirements specified above'; sample-location and cross-reference interpretation affects which monitoring obligations apply and whether available measurements satisfy required evidence."
    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "The permittee is required to submit a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water intake within six months after the effective date of the permit to both EPA and NMED for approval.",
      "affected_purpose": "B",
      "computation_change_reason": "Creates a time-bounded plan-submission obligation tied to permit effective date; whether FY2025 falls inside or outside that six-month window changes whether plan submission monitoring was required."
    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "Once approved, the permittee must collect and analyze samples for delta-BHC at least once a quarter or more frequent during the 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th year of the permit.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Monitoring is conditional on plan approval and only during specific permit years at quarterly-or-greater frequency; mapping Federal FY2025 to permit year and approval status changes whether delta-BHC monitoring was required and how missing results should be classified."
    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "The results of this study shall be attached to the DMR reports to EPA.",
      "affected_purpose": "C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Specifies the evidentiary channel for delta-BHC study results; interpretation affects whether absent DMR attachments represent documented no-data, unmet reporting, or unresolved missing evidence."
    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "Discharge Monitoring Report Form(s) shall be submitted quarterly. Each quarterly submittal shall include separate forms for each month of the reporting period.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Defines quarterly reporting with separate monthly forms, establishing month-level monitoring/reporting expectations that affect which months require evidence and how missing monthly results are evaluated."
    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "Reporting periods shall end on the last day of the months March, June, September, and December.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Fixes reporting-period boundaries that intersect Federal FY2025; different alignment of calendar quarters to FY2025 months changes which monitoring periods were in scope and whether gaps are unresolved."
    },
    {
      "source": "aztec/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "page 5, section part_i",
      "exact_span": "The first Discharge Monitoring Report(s) shall represent facility operations from the effective date of the permit through the last day of the current reporting period.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Sets a transitional first-reporting window from permit effective date; if FY2025 overlaps that initial period, interpretation of 'current reporting period' changes expected monitoring coverage and missing-evidence classification for early months."
    }
  ]
}
